what_to_detect: A decision candidate that casts a spell through its Spectacle alternative cost is playable (can_play true): an opponent of its controller lost life this turn.
near_miss: A Spectacle-cost candidate that is not playable (can_play false), because no opponent of its controller lost life this turn.
record_fields: candidates[].ability (the Spectacle keyword line: script_api_type Keyword, so no api selects it; keyword_display_name does)
